name: MSE 4001
title: Electrical and Magnetic Properties of Materials
description: Principles underlying electrical and magnetic behavior will be applied to the selection and design of materials. Topics covered will include: thermoelectricity, photoelectricity, conductors, semiconductors, superconductors, dielectrics, ferroelectrics, piezoelectricity, pyroelectricity, and magnetism. Device applications.
requirement_description: MSE 2101 or both PHYS 1502Q and MSE 2001.
